summary: Shenzhen Electron Technology Co., Ltd. (branded ELC), founded in 2008 and headquartered in Shenzhen, China, is a digital-signage and smart-display hardware manufacturer with OEM/ODM capabilities spanning self-ordering kiosks, POS cashier displays, handheld ordering tablets, and kitchen display systems for the restaurant industry, operating a 30,000-square-meter facility with 1,000+ employees including a 200-person R&D team.
